subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should this issue close after a focused active-agent plus workspace breadcrumb lands, or should closure require the broader switch feedback, live-target proof, and optional identity/switcher/prefix UX?
rationale: Current main lacks workspace header context, the focused closing PR is open but conflicting, and another open UI PR removes the breadcrumb surface, so automation cannot choose the final Dashboard header product contract.

options.title: Land Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Keep this issue open until a rebased focused breadcrumb lands, then close it while tracking optional switcher, prefix, and live-target proof ideas separately.

options.title: Broaden Before Closure
options.body: Require the implementation to also cover switch confirmation and stronger live-target proof before this issue can close.

options.title: Replace Header Surface
options.body: Choose the no-breadcrumb/topbar direction and redesign multi-agent/workspace certainty in another persistent UI surface before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Land Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a rebased focused breadcrumb lands, then close it while tracking optional switcher, prefix, and live-target proof ideas separately.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev introduced the current active-agent Dashboard header context, making them the strongest history match for the header UX contract.
